text:
jordan: quick QA on inventory list at ~375px. right action drawer overlaps last column and pushes chips into overflow. screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/ss-375.png
mei: repro'd in staging. sequence: collapse left nav, open item, rotate to portrait, tap search.
sam: simple CSS fix we tried: drop row min-height 56->48 at <=420px, and make drawer full-width sheet on narrow. snippet: @media(max-width:420px){ .row{min-height:48px} .side-drawer{position:fixed;left:0;right:0} }
alex: prefer sheet pattern for discoverability and larger hit area for close.
maya: a11y: announce "Item actions dialog" when sheet opens, focus trap, role=dialog + aria-modal, and ensure close is 44px. tab order must reach overflow menu.
mei: copy: change "More actions" -> "Actions" on compact screens to avoid wrap. hide low-priority badges (cost/tags) under 420px.
jordan: add narrow breakpoint at 360px to collapse "tags" and "region" into details flyout.
sam: plan: columns full >=768, reduced 420-767, minimal <420. i'll prototype and open PR.
design-bot: preview: https://staging.redwood/preview/tx-412 (compact rows + sheet for <420).
maya: UX test: quick 1-thumb reach check for close/primary actions tomorrow.
jordan: ok, sam add a11y checklist to PR. aim for next sprint. :thumbsup:
